STEP 1 - Scene: warm side salad or small plated dish of roasted mushrooms, chickpeas and leafy greens
STEP 2 - Vessel: white square plate ~26 cm, area 3.14 x 13^2 = 531 cm^2
STEP 3 - Items: dark roasted mushroom/grain mound; chickpeas; arugula/leafy greens; no visible oil or sauce
STEP 4 - Area: mushroom mound 12% + chickpeas 7% + greens 6% = 25% of vessel (~133 cm^2)
STEP 5 - Volume:
- mushroom mound 64 cm^2 x 2 cm = 128 ml
- chickpeas 37 cm^2 x 1 cm = 37 ml
- greens 32 cm^2 x 2 cm = 64 ml
STEP 6 - Grams:
- mushroom 128 ml x 0.9 = 115 g
- chickpeas 37 ml x 0.6 = 22 g
- greens 64 ml x 0.15 = 10 g
- total 147 g
STEP 7 - Energy:
- mushroom 115 g x 30 kcal/100g = 35 kcal
- chickpeas 22 g x 164 kcal/100g = 36 kcal
- greens 10 g x 25 kcal/100g = 3 kcal
- total 74 kcal
STEP 8 - Sanity check: a quarter-covered plate with a small pile of mushrooms, chickpeas and greens at ~150 g and ~75 kcal is plausible.
